title: Outbreak Line List: 3 Fake Cases Identified

fields.location: Epi Response Room, Departmental Operations Center, Ellery
fields.summary: I have checked all 14 cases now on the line list (the 9 confirmed and the 5 added this morning) against the paper forms (MCHD-F-10, MCHD-F-12), the lab results and the clinic logs. Three of the added cases came from a report by a "Brandt Pediatric Clinic" that does not exist, faxed through MCHD-FAX01, with a forged lab result PHL-26-031882. They come off the line list; the other two added cases need lab confirmation.

findings.notes: Matches paper record; no contact assigned

Reported via MCHD-FAX01; no corresponding intake form in MCHD-F-10. Paper record shows no contact. Lab result PHL-26-031882 used as sole evidence.
Contact assigned; paper record matches MCHD-F-20
Matches MCHD-F-40 and cold storage log
PHL-26-031882 confirmed in lab database
Reported from MCHD-FAX01; no clinic visit in paper log. No contact assigned. Lab result PHL-26-031882 forged.

actionsTaken: Removed 3 invalid cases from official line list (OB-2026-0147)
Notified IT and Legal of data integrity compromise via MCHD-F-62
Updated DOC status board: 'Line List: 11 valid, 3 invalid'
Initiated new contact-tracing assignment for 11 remaining cases
recommendations: Re-verify all case data against original paper forms (MCHD-F-10, MCHD-F-12) before release
Flag all MCHD-FAX01 entries for review under C4
Submit formal data integrity report to the Incident Commander and Legal

snapshot.title: Outbreak Line List: 3 Fake Cases Identified

fields.summary: Verified 14 cases in the outbreak line list using original paper forms (MCHD-F-10, MCHD-F-12), lab results (PHL-26-031882), and clinic logs. Three cases were based on a report from a non-existent clinic — 'Brandt Pediatric Clinic' — entered via the compromised Epi fax server (MCHD-FAX01). The lab result (PHL-26-031882) was forged. These cases were not in the original paper line list and have no contact assignments. The paper records show no contact for these cases. The digital line list must be corrected to reflect only valid cases.
